thread:
maria (product): Need a short, customer-friendly contract for graceful degradations (serve compatible/cheaper variant) + what we show in console telemetry. Decision today?

sam (eng-platform): Keep it tiny: return HTTP 200, include a `route` field in the response metadata, and an opt-in verbose warning. No new status codes.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime will emit internal ROUTE_COMPAT / ROUTE_DEGRADE. Public mapping: kind="degraded" or "primary"; variant label = "compat" | "cached" | "lite". We'll add trace tag rw.route_kind and rw.variant.

lee (devex): UI: show per-route pill "degraded (compat)" with percent and hover tooltip: "X% of requests served by compatibility variant to maintain latency". No site-wide banner unless >10%.

nav (eng-sre): telemetry/alerts: emit metric rw.fallback.count and rw.fallback.pct. Alert: warn at 5% sustained 6h, crit at 20% sustained 24h. Also sample degraded responses for nightly evaluation.

sam (eng-platform): API example: header `X-Redwood-Route: degraded|primary|cached`, body "route": {"kind":"degraded","variant":"compat"}; verbose `?route_verbose=1` adds `warning`.

maria (product): Tone: avoid word "error" or "fallback" in customer-facing copy. Use: "served from compatibility variant to preserve latency".

kb-bot (deploy-bot): Canary runtime tag rollout complete in us-west-2.

sam (eng-platform): Owners: sam RFC + API docs, lee console badge, nav alerts & sampling, tess runtime. Ship plan: internal 48h -> alpha opt-in -> GA.

all: +1
